ideas.title: The Impact of Child Care Fraud on Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of child care fraud on Minnesota, including the effects on families and the state's economy.
ideas.angle: The human impact of child care fraud
questions: What is the extent of child care fraud in Minnesota?
How has child care fraud affected families in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the human impact of child care fraud and the need for accountability in government programs.
